$comment: Environments, declared once and in promotion order (ADR-001 amendments 12, 13): a host run reads one (`.env.<id>`), a target tree splits by them, CD promotes through them in this order. workspace: the environment remote dev syncs source into. runDefault: what a host run reads without --env; deployDefault: what a deploy targets without one. requireClean: a release to it is refused from a dirty checkout. rollbackOnFailure: a release whose health fails is rolled back to the previous one. confirm: a deploy, rollback or removal there asks first (`--yes` answers for CI). requireDigests: every image a release runs is pinned by digest. A host adds one (e.g. staging) in its manifest (`catalogs.environments`, with `after`) and touches no code.
